choice.basis: The public dashboard chart 'United States vs Canada' shows the 2012.0 values. The United States (blue line) is at 139, while Canada (red dashed line) is at 32. The routing criterion is the 'Larger 2012 country indicator value'. Since 139 > 32, the United States has the larger value.
